steps.eval: (() => { const cab = document.querySelector('.y-dsc-cab'); const y = scrollY; let stopped = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) { const e = new WheelEvent('wheel', { deltaY: 30, bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); cab.dispatchEvent(e); if (e.defaultPrevented) stopped++; } return [stopped, scrollY === y]; })()

(() => { window.__before = JSON.stringify([Object.entries(localStorage).filter(([k]) => k !== 'yapp-sim-lock').sort(), Object.entries(sessionStorage).sort(), document.cookie]); document.querySelector('.y-dsc-app').scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); return !!window.__before })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('.y-dsc-app iframe').contentDocument; const b = [...d.querySelectorAll('.y-reel-cta')].find((x) => { const r = x.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.top > 0 && r.bottom < 956; }); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return b.textContent.trim(); })()

(() => { const d = document.querySelector('.y-dsc-app iframe').contentDocument; return [d.querySelector('.y-appview-note').textContent, d.location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '').endsWith('/app-preview')]; })()
